title: Exact measured resolution refutation verification
claims: ExactResolutionRefutationVerifier checks the exact canonical resolution refutation relation and proves that acceptance implies unsatisfiability.
MeasuredClauseSetEquality and MeasuredResolutionStep check finite-set equality and exact one-pivot resolution on canonical list clauses.
MeasuredResolutionDerivation validates newest-first traces with parents drawn solely from the older suffix.
MeasuredClauseSuffixChecks lifts an arbitrary measured local clause check to all successive trace suffixes.
BoundedResolutionRefutationsInNP places the polynomially encoded resolution-certificate language in NP.
ResolutionDerivationIsRUP proves that the original resolution trace is also a RUP learning run without adding any clauses.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
